name: Web
description: Search the web and read pages. search_web and search_news query the Brave Search API (needs a free API key); fetch_url retrieves any http(s) page and returns it as readable text, and needs no key at all. fetch_url is also how a face reaches an HTTP API it cannot call itself — a face runs on an opaque origin, so its own fetch is blocked by CORS for most hosts, while a pack request carries no Origin.
summary: Search the web with Brave and fetch any http(s) page as readable text.

brave_api_key.description: Brave Search API key — needed for search_web / search_news only; fetch_url works without it. Free tier at https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/
